faces.transcription: Take 1 Action token and give it to 1 player.
faces.flavor: The team interrogated the KGB officer. The man gloated, indicating that you failed to grasp the true purpose of the control centers: they are the cornerstone of the MEDUSA dispersal plan, an operation they call "LION'S TOOTH."
